name: castling-decline-first-target-still-offers-the-second
notes: Castling: 'up to two target Chessman allies': the first target is declined, the second one is chosen. Declining the first used to skip CastlingFirstTarget, so the second target was never offered.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Castling's optional-choice continuation (CastlingFirstTarget) handles the declined choice itself, but Core's ExecuteStaticMethods() skipped it on PASS (it was queued by a generated card body without dontSkipOnPass): the second target was never offered after the first was declined. Fix: Grand Archive registers the handler as decline-aware (GameCustomHandlerRunsOnPass, asked by Core before it skips) and the handler consumes the decline with ConsumeDeclinedChoice().
